name: ticker_analysis_workflow
objective: Produce a validated ticker context package and guide a non-deterministic AI response without guaranteed investment advice.

steps.name: receive_ticker
steps.action: Accept ticker and scope; do not query automatically.

steps.name: check_coverage
steps.action: Read aggregate summary; mark per-ticker coverage unknown until a real read-only adapter exists.

steps.name: build_context_package
steps.action: Build template-compatible skeleton; attach no invented values.

steps.name: validate_context
steps.action: Apply required keys, provenance, missing, stale and point-in-time controls.

steps.name: send_context_to_ai
steps.action: Provide only validated context plus knowledge rules; preserve warnings.

steps.name: ai_response
steps.action: Follow AnalysisGuide and AIUsageRules; separate fact, derived calculation, inference and scenario.

response_constraints: State data cutoff, missing sections, conflicts and limitations.
allowed_actions: write new context package to approved export path
limitations: Phase 4 builder does not implement real ticker data adapters.
